title: 09 Export
subtitle: One Export sheet that fits what's selected and always shows its Scope — live paper for print, a filmstrip for video, batch, progress, history, link vs file, handoff — Alligators brand, Studio site, Portfolio 2026
brief: export — every export path that exists today stays reachable (PNG, PDF, SVG, HTML, PowerPoint, MP4, GIF, WebM, Canva, Project ZIP, AI handoff; print PDF with bleed and crop marks; cloud render; the Exports history; /design:handoff, /design:to-rn, /design:to-lottie), redrawn for designers: a sheet that adapts to a social post, a print artboard, a web page or a video, with a Scope row (Selection · This canvas · Folder · Whole project) on every sheet; ⇧⌘E with nothing selected exports this canvas; a live paper preview for print and a filmstrip for video; the inspector's export row; a whole folder grouped by kind; progress in words; one-action toasts (done = Show in Finder, partial = Retry the one that failed); a link instead of a file; handoff to production with a command that runs on any machine, plus its no-AI / offline / blockers cases; offline, the whole project on purpose, safe-margin and font warnings, a viewer exporting, AI still changing the artboard; Advanced with scale or dpi, colour profile, video settings, file-name tokens and the command.

artboards.label: 1 · A social post → PNG or JPG
artboards.note: A post exports at Instagram's own size — 1×, PNG; Scope on top shows every count, so widening is one click.

artboards.label: 2 · A print artboard → Print PDF, on paper
artboards.note: The preview is the PDF: crop marks draw in, the bleed is tinted, the back sits under the front as page 2.

artboards.label: 3 · A web artboard → full page, or PDF
artboards.note: Image takes the full page; Code isn't a format — a link at the foot opens Handoff to production.

artboards.label: 4 · A video artboard → MP4, GIF or sound, with a filmstrip
artboards.note: A filmstrip of the whole edit, both formats ticked, captions, and where it renders — 4K suggests the cloud.

artboards.label: 5 · No sheet at all — the inspector's export row, Copy as PNG
artboards.note: The artboard keeps its own export sizes in the inspector; ⇧⌘C copies it as a PNG.

artboards.label: 6 · Other… — every format, one list away
artboards.note: Every format grouped by what you're making; the ones that don't fit say why. The ways in.

artboards.label: 7 · ⇧⌘E with nothing selected → this canvas
artboards.note: Nothing selected exports this canvas — Combine-kampan's 21 artboards by kind (19 fixed size, 2 print), never the whole project.

artboards.label: 8 · Five artboards, two kinds
artboards.note: Four fixed-size posts and a score-card print sheet on Combine-kampan — one sheet, a group per kind, one button.

artboards.label: 9 · Export a folder — grouped by kind
artboards.note: Right-click social › Export folder… opens Scope on Folder; fixed size and video each get their own default.

artboards.label: 10 · Rendering in the cloud — keep working
artboards.note: The Exports icon in the Share cluster carries a ring; each row says where it runs.

artboards.label: 11 · Cloud or this Mac, done, partly done
artboards.note: Done = Show in Finder; a partial export says 114 of 115 and retries only Recap.

artboards.label: 12 · Exports panel — again, open folder, retry the one that failed
artboards.note: The last 20 exports: social · 114 of 115 with Retry Recap, Show in Finder, Export again.

artboards.label: 13 · Share link vs Export
artboards.note: Export offers a link once when the people are already in the project; Share is 10's sheet; Portfolio 2026 is local.

artboards.label: 14 · ⇧⌘H — pick where the code goes
artboards.note: Targets from the project settings (web registry, React Native, Lottie); the last review shown in words.

artboards.label: 15 · Ready — one thing to copy; Advanced shows the rest
artboards.note: The web command fetches Pricing from Studio site's cloud address; the file:// form is under Advanced, This Mac only.

artboards.label: 16 · Handoff without AI, offline, or with review blockers
artboards.note: Connect sheet on first use, queued offline, blockers travel with the code as notes.

artboards.label: 17 · Offline — this Mac renders, the cloud waits
artboards.note: The same video rows as online; renders on this Mac now, or waits for the cloud.

artboards.label: 18 · Whole project, chosen in Scope — 93 canvases
artboards.note: 524 artboards by kind, each part saying where it runs and how long; Project ZIP is the alternative.

artboards.label: 19 · Past the safe margin; a font that won't embed
artboards.note: The QR code 2 mm inside the cut is ringed on the paper; an .otf that can't embed becomes shapes. Export still exports.

artboards.label: 20 · A viewer exports; AI is still changing it
artboards.note: Viewers may export (a copy changes nothing); handoff needs Can edit; mid-AI, choose 14:05 or wait for AI.

artboards.label: 21 · Export › Advanced, per kind
artboards.note: Scale or dpi (one wins), colour profile, PDF text and marks, frame rate and codec, where it renders, file-name tokens, the commands.
